## Recent developments

OpenAI has experienced a dense and highly transformative product deployment cycle leading up to November 2026. Over the past 30 days, the company has heavily emphasized agentic workflows, expanded monetization vectors, security-focused enterprise tiers, and infrastructural model updates. A primary focal point is the introduction of **Business Hub in ChatGPT**, announced in November 2026, which allows eligible U.S. ecommerce and online service organizations to claim their corporate presence, connect verified product feeds, and deploy customized **Business Agents** to directly answer customer inquiries ([OpenAI, 2026](https://releasebot.io/updates/openai)).
